bible.title: The Passkeeper's Toll
bible.kernel: A burner hires the company to fetch the outlaw who keeps the winter pass open by feeding a chained beast.

cast.name: Amee
cast.who: A charcoal-burner from the western camps who lost stores to nightly theft.
cast.want: to have the raider captured and handed over to her camp for punishment

cast.name: Nerile
cast.who: A forest seer who tends the chained creature at the pass and demands passage in return.
cast.want: to keep the creature fed and retain control of safe passage through the pass

cast.name: Lysippos
cast.who: A scrawny, clumsy road thief from the forest gangs who steals charcoal to feed his scheme.
cast.want: to avoid custody and keep feeding the beast that keeps the road open

bible.situation: A chained, feral hobgoblin-like beast is kept fed at the Rimeward Pass so the road stays clear in winter. A scrawny thief runs charcoal and food to it and steals from the burners to pay for the creature. A forest seer tends the creature and enforces toll and habit. She tolerates the feeder so the pass stays open.
bible.goal: to capture the brigand who has been raiding the charcoal-burners' stores and hand them over to the camp that hired the company
arc: Go to the charcoal-burners' camp at Fallow Hut and question the burners there about nightly feeders on the winter pass → yields: Kebes, a battered burner who points toward Rimeward Pass and swears he saw a man leave food sacks at dusk.

Use Kebes's lead to stake out Rimeward Pass and watch for whoever keeps the road open → yields: Nerile, the grim seer who tends a chained hobgoblin beast and says the feeder slips south toward Pineward Camp.

Track the feeder Nerile named down to Pineward Camp, seize the scrawny man bringing sacks from the pass, and return him to Amee at the burners' camp where Nerile will stand to stop the handover → yields: Lysippos bound and handed to Amee after Nerile is driven off, bought, or outwitted.
tensions: The chained hobgoblin beast will attack anyone who nears the pass.
Nerile claims stewardship of the pass and will block any handover to outsiders.
Lysippos is clumsy and savage in a fight. He will flee or lash out when caught.
openDirections: If the beast goes unfed or its keeper is removed, the pass will ice over and outside patrols or desperate raiders will press into the area.
bible.stakeIfLost: the burners will lose their winter supply when the raider keeps stealing, leaving the camps without fuel and cutting off trade through the pass
bible.arrival: was waiting at first light · wanted it settled the same day

shipped.title: Question burners at Fallow Hut
shipped.situation: A burner, Amee, waited at first light and held her gloves while she spoke. She says the raider will keep stealing and the burners will lose their winter supply, leaving the camps without fuel and cutting off trade through the pass. Find what the burners at Fallow Hut know about nightly feeders on the winter pass, the pay is plain coin, and the road's yield goes to the company. A seer opposes this and will try to keep the creature fed and retain control of safe passage. She held her gloves and demanded it be settled the same day.
shipped.job: Question the burners at Fallow Hut about nightly feeders on the winter pass.
